tool: Built-in GPT Image, latest exposed; tool returns no model/version identifier
method: Individual native 8x pose + concept + approved pilot; largest alpha component, native ink-box normalization, fixed unchanged palette, inside ink, mapping mask and alias projection. Rows are final original MICA pixels, no native pixels. Legacy generators produce earlier artwork; restore via wave3/native_pose_stages.py --rebuild.
limitations: Art-only; no runtime, board palette-sharing, occlusion or animation certification. Fixed variants retain manifest LUT and native palette as compatibility approximations.

frames.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one native game sprite, s3k-slot-96. Reference 1 is the 8x nearest-neighbour native POSE ONLY. Reference 2 is MICA's identity concept. Reference 3 is the approved MICA pixel style. Redraw the character from scratch as MICA the ORIGINAL pangolin; never recolour Sonic. Follow EXACT curled/rolling pose and orientation in reference 1; show rounded overlapping jade scale armour wrapping the pangolin, with tucked cream muzzle, gloves or boots ONLY where this pose reveals them. Preserve exact pose, bounding-box proportions, framing and relative limb sizes. Jade rounded overlapping scales, tapered scaled tail, cream skin, coral hiking boots with tan soles, white gloves. Faithful chunky 16-bit pixel art with crisp clusters, dark outline, restrained highlights, no blur. Transparent background; one isolated sprite only, no text, no floor/shadow, no effects. NO Sonic quills, spikes, blue fur or Sonic shoes. No added front face when viewed from behind. This frame belongs to a coherent animation; keep scale size and body proportions consistent with the anchors.
